name: @pipeworx/mcp-emarket-storage

tools.name: emarket_search_disclosures
tools.description: Search Italian regulated company disclosures from eMarket Storage (Teleborsa), one of Italy's two EU Transparency Directive Officially Appointed Mechanisms. PREFER OVER esef_filing_search FOR ITALIAN ISSUERS COVERED HERE — this source is updated same-day, unlike the community ESEF index which runs months behind. Identify the issuer with company (free-text name, resolved against eMarket's own ~480-issuer list) or azienda_id (Teleborsa's internal numeric id, from a prior result) — there is no ISIN/LEI field on this source. BOTH ARE OPTIONAL — omit company/azienda_id entirely to get every covered issuer's disclosures in the date window in ONE call (page with limit/offset, page_size=24, only if that day's volume exceeds one page); cheaper than one call per issuer for a multi-issuer daily check. date_to IS INCLUSIVE (the last day you want included) — this tool handles the underlying source's own date_to being EXCLUSIVE by always querying one calendar day past it, so date_from="2026-09-21", date_to="2026-09-22" correctly returns rows from BOTH the 21st and the 22nd; a single date_from with no date_to searches just that one day. COVERAGE: only issuers that disclose through eMarket Storage — a second Italian mechanism, 1INFO, covers a separate set of issuers (e.g. IREN, SOMEC) and is NOT included; use oneinfo-storage's oneinfo_search_disclosures for those. An unmatched company name is reported as "not an eMarket Storage issuer", not as an error. Category codes: 100=1.1 Relazioni finanziarie annuali e relazioni di revisione annuali; 101=1.2 Relazioni finanziarie semestrali e revisioni limitate; 102=1.3 Pagamento ai governi; 103=2.1 Stato membro d'origine; 104=2.2 Informazioni privilegiate; 105=2.3 Notifiche di partecipazioni rilevanti; 106=2.4 Acquisizione o cessione di azioni proprie dell'emittente; 107=2.5 Totale dei diritti di voto e del capitale; 108=2.6 Modifiche dei diritti inerenti alle categorie di azioni o valori mobiliari; 109=3.1 Ulteriori informazioni previste dalla regolamentazione nazionale; 110=MANTRA — Internal Dealing (operazioni di persone rilevanti e strettamente associate); 111=MANRSS — Relazione sulla gestione inclusa la dichiarazione di sostenibilità; 150=REGEM — Altre informazioni regolamentate (art. 65-ter Regolamento Consob 11971/1999). Returns disclosure EVENTS (title, company, timestamp, PDF link) — NOT extracted XBRL facts.

company.description: Free-text issuer name, e.g. "Saipem", "amplifon". Resolved against eMarket Storage's own issuer picklist (name match, not a fulltext search). If it matches more than one issuer equally well, the response lists the candidates instead of guessing — retry with azienda_id.

azienda_id.description: Teleborsa's internal issuer id, e.g. "1247" (Saipem). Use the value returned by a previous company search to skip name resolution.

category.description: EU Transparency Directive category code to filter by, e.g. "104" for Informazioni privilegiate. See tool description for the full code list. When set, every returned row is tagged with this category (the source does not expose a category on the row itself, only as a search filter — so category is null on unfiltered results).

market.description: Exact market/segment name to filter by, e.g. "Euronext Milan", "Euronext STAR Milan", "MTA". Must match eMarket Storage's own market label exactly; omit if unsure.

cerca.description: Full-text search across disclosure titles and attachment contents.

date_from.description: Only disclosures published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). If date_to is omitted, this tool searches just this one day.

date_to.description: Only disclosures published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, INCLUSIVE — the last day you want included). The upstream source's own date_to parameter is EXCLUSIVE of that day, so this tool always adds one calendar day internally before querying; the response echoes both your inclusive date_to and the exclusive bound actually sent upstream.

limit.description: Number of disclosures to return (1-24). Default 10. The underlying source pages in fixed blocks of 24; a limit/offset combination that crosses a page boundary returns only the remainder of that page — use has_more and increase offset by 24 to page further.

tools.name: emarket_get_disclosure
tools.description: Fetch a single eMarket Storage disclosure by its Teleborsa protocollo id and publication date, as returned by emarket_search_disclosures. This source has no by-id lookup endpoint, only by-day listings, so both id and date are required. Returns the shaped record — company, title, category (if known), timestamp, and the document (PDF) URL.

id.description: Teleborsa protocollo id, e.g. "189482", from an emarket_search_disclosures result.

date.description: The disclosure's publication date (YYYY-MM-DD), from the same search result (published_at_local's date part).

tools.name: emarket_search_documents
tools.description: Search eMarket Storage's DOCUMENT ARCHIVE — a SEPARATE repository from emarket_search_disclosures' press-release stream, covering the actual regulated filings: annual/half-year financial reports, ESEF/XBRL packages, AGM documentation and similar. Use this (not emarket_search_disclosures) when you need the annual report or ESEF package itself, not an issuer's press release ABOUT it — verified live 2026-10-19: Interpump's category=100 on emarket_search_disclosures returns only its results press release, while this tool's category=100 on the same issuer returns "IP - Annual Financial Report 2025" plus its ESEF XBRL ZIP. Same issuer ids, category codes, and INCLUSIVE date_to convention as emarket_search_disclosures — see that tool's description for the date-window mechanics. has_xbrl flags rows that carry a downloadable ESEF/XBRL ZIP (document_url then points at the .zip, not a .pdf). Category codes: 100=1.1 Relazioni finanziarie annuali e relazioni di revisione annuali; 101=1.2 Relazioni finanziarie semestrali e revisioni limitate; 102=1.3 Pagamento ai governi; 103=2.1 Stato membro d'origine; 104=2.2 Informazioni privilegiate; 105=2.3 Notifiche di partecipazioni rilevanti; 106=2.4 Acquisizione o cessione di azioni proprie dell'emittente; 107=2.5 Totale dei diritti di voto e del capitale; 108=2.6 Modifiche dei diritti inerenti alle categorie di azioni o valori mobiliari; 109=3.1 Ulteriori informazioni previste dalla regolamentazione nazionale; 110=MANTRA — Internal Dealing (operazioni di persone rilevanti e strettamente associate); 111=MANRSS — Relazione sulla gestione inclusa la dichiarazione di sostenibilità; 150=REGEM — Altre informazioni regolamentate (art. 65-ter Regolamento Consob 11971/1999).

company.description: Free-text issuer name, e.g. "Interpump", "Saipem". Resolved against the same issuer picklist as emarket_search_disclosures. Optional — omit along with azienda_id to get every issuer's documents in the date window in one call.

azienda_id.description: Teleborsa's internal issuer id, from a prior emarket_search_disclosures or emarket_search_documents result.

category.description: Category code to filter by, e.g. "100" for annual financial reports/ESEF packages. See tool description for the full code list.

date_from.description: Only documents published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). If date_to is omitted, searches just this one day.

date_to.description: Only documents published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, INCLUSIVE). Same exclusive-upstream-bound handling as emarket_search_disclosures.

limit.description: Number of documents to return (1-24). Default 10.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-emarket-storage forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the emarket-storage pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
